instruction: A candid documentary photograph in a medium-wide, eye-level shot captures an indoor studio with a red carpet and dark red partition screens. The man in the dark polo shirt and blue shorts (R1) stands in the foreground with his back to the camera, reaching towards the woman in the white patterned t-shirt and blue jeans (R2). The woman (R2) stands in the background right, facing forward-left, looking at the man with a neutral expression. The man (R1) touches her right arm near the elbow. The scene features even indoor lighting with a dominant red and white color palette.
